cleaning_notes: Source: two PDF tables converted with pdftotext -layout (S1 leukocytes, S2 SAA/CRP/cytokines); page headers repeat (3 in S1, 3 in S2) and were skipped. 112 dogs, the same IDs in both files.
Rows 'CaseN' -> group infected, timepoint admission; rows 'ControlK' -> group control, timepoint single. Blood was taken at presentation before treatment (article full text).
Outcome (Survived/Died, infected only) -> outcomes file 'died'; controls have no Outcome and died = null. Original row IDs are kept only in the outcomes file.
NEUT -> neut_seg: the article's Table 1 labels it the segmented neutrophil count. Band neutrophils are not in the file.

Cytokine floors (record; the article sets values below the detection limit to the minimum detectable concentration): IL-2 3.4, IL-6 3.6, IL-10 8.4, IL-18 5.7, GM-CSF 9.1; flagged censored = floor. Counts at floor: il2 30, il6 11, il10 5, il18 4, gmcsf 28.

Ceilings: S-CB517:d101 has 50000.0 in IL-2, IL-6, IL-18 and GM-CSF (S-CB050 gives 50001.0 for the same cells); SAA 3001.0 in 4 infected dogs is read as an above-range code (inferred; S-CB517:d023 has 3017.1, so this is uncertain and only exact 3001.0 is flagged). Kept and flagged censored = ceiling (S-CB517:d062 saa; S-CB517:d043 saa; S-CB517:d078 saa; S-CB517:d101 gmcsf; S-CB517:d101 il18; S-CB517:d101 il2; S-CB517:d101 il6; S-CB517:d059 saa).
IL-8 and MCP-1 have no documented floor; the IL-8 minimum 21.6 occurs in 3 dogs (not flagged).
No sex, age, weight, band count or days sick in these files.

Same dogs as S-CB050 (never pool): 112 of 112 rows linked by value (7 cytokines + WBC + segmented neutrophils; best match >= 7 of 9 equal values and at least 4 more than the next best; floor values make 3-4 chance matches common). The best value match is the case implied by the ID (CaseN -> S-CB050 case N; ControlK -> S-CB050 case 200+K) in 112 of 112 rows. Field same_dog_as gives the S-CB050 dog_id.

Comparison with S-CB050 (computed from values; it had not been made before): il2 111/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; il6 111/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; il8 112/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; il10 112/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; il18 111/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; gmcsf 111/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0; mcp1 112/112 equal, 112 within 1%, rho 1.0. Also wbc 88/112 equal, 88 within 1%; neut_seg 112/112 equal, 112 within 1%. Died agrees in 97 of 97 infected dogs. Both files keep their own values; see checks file key scb050_comparison for the mismatching pairs.

FLAG WBC: S-CB517 WBC differs from S-CB050 WBC in 24 linked dogs, always higher here. In 24 of them the S-CB050 WBC equals NEUT+LYMPH+MONO+EOS of this file plus the S-CB050 band count (within 0.25), so the S1 WBC column looks like a different (uncorrected or mis-entered) total; the published Table 1 median WBC of infected dogs (6.2) matches the S-CB050 values (median 6.22), not this file (median 6.29). Values kept as reported. Prefer S-CB050 WBC for these dogs. The FLAG lines below on differentials far below WBC are mostly the same dogs.
Died includes euthanasia for poor prognosis (article full text); the label is only in the outcomes file.
No value was changed.
